'''Sarala''' was a fair-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="A Hero's Rest" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Garbed in the traditional [[Black|dark]] [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master and wielding a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Sarala was stationed on the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] staging area of [[Carrick Station]] near the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] alongside the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Briqui]] and Master [[Cassa Hun]].<ref name="A Hero's Rest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sarala first appeared in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released in [[2011]], where she is located on Carrick Station. They deliver an experience reward to Jedi Knight players in the mission "A Hero's Rest," at the end of Act I,<ref name="A Hero's Rest" /> and in the mission "Returning to the Fight" at the end of Act II.<ref name="Returning to the Fight">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Returning to the Fight|Carrick Station}}</ref>
